mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalUserCount, SUM(CASE WHEN member_type = '일반회원' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalPersonalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN member_type = '파트너회원' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalPartnerCount, SUM(CASE WHEN member_type = '전문가회원' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalExpertCount, SUM(CASE WHEN member_type = '관리자' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalAdminCount, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(created_date) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayJoinCount FROM user

WITH RECURSIVE months AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 5 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01' ) AS month_start UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(month_start, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') FROM months WHERE month_start < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') ), agg AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM user WHERE #{memberScope} = 'ALL' OR (#{memberScope} = 'PERSONAL' AND member_type = '일반회원') OR (#{memberScope} = 'PARTNER' AND member_type = '파트너회원') OR (#{memberScope} = 'EXPERT' AND member_type = '전문가회원') OR (#{memberScope} = 'ADMIN' AND member_type = '관리자') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_date, '%Y-%m-01') ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(m.month_start, '%Y-%m') AS label, IFNULL(a.cnt, 0) AS value FROM months m LEFT JOIN agg a ON a.month_start = m.month_start ORDER BY m.month_start

SELECT COUNT(*) AS inquiryTotalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(b.created_date) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inquiryNewCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.reply_count IS NULL OR r.reply_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inquiryUnreadCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.reply_count IS NOT NULL AND r.reply_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inquiryInProgressCount FROM board b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS reply_count FROM board_reply GROUP BY post_id ) r ON r.post_id = b.post_id WHERE b.deleted = 0 AND b.category_id = #{inquiryCategoryId}

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN b.deleted = 0 THEN 1 END) AS totalPostCount,
COUNT(CASE WHEN b.deleted = 0 AND c.category_name = '자유게시판' THEN 1 END) AS freeCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN b.deleted = 0 AND c.category_name = '자유게시판' AND DATE(b.created_date) = CURDATE() THEN 1 END) AS freeTodayCount,
COUNT(CASE WHEN b.deleted = 0 AND c.category_name = '건강 Q&A' THEN 1 END) AS qnaCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN b.deleted = 0 AND c.category_name = '건강 Q&A' AND DATE(b.created_date) = CURDATE() THEN 1 END) AS qnaTodayCount,
COUNT(CASE WHEN b.deleted = 0 AND c.category_name = '카드뉴스' THEN 1 END) AS cardnewsCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN b.deleted = 0 AND c.category_name = '카드뉴스' AND DATE(b.created_date) = CURDATE() THEN 1 END) AS cardnewsTodayCount,
COUNT(CASE WHEN b.deleted = 0 AND c.category_name = '관리자에게' THEN 1 END) AS inquiryPostCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN b.deleted = 0 AND c.category_name = '관리자에게' AND DATE(b.created_date) = CURDATE() THEN 1 END) AS inquiryTodayPostCount FROM board b JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.category_id

SELECT b.post_id AS postId, b.title AS title, b.view_count AS viewCount, COUNT(bl.member_id) AS likeCount, c.category_name AS categoryName, DATE_FORMAT(b.created_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createdDate FROM board b JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN board_like bl ON b.post_id = bl.post_id WHERE b.deleted = 0 GROUP BY b.post_id, b.title, b.view_count, c.category_name, b.created_date ORDER BY b.view_count DESC, likeCount DESC, b.created_date DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT b.post_id AS postId, b.title AS title, b.view_count AS viewCount, COUNT(bl.member_id) AS likeCount, c.category_name AS categoryName, DATE_FORMAT(b.created_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdDate FROM board b JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN board_like bl ON b.post_id = bl.post_id WHERE b.deleted = 0 GROUP BY b.post_id, b.title, b.view_count, c.category_name, b.created_date ORDER BY b.created_date DESC LIMIT 5
